item.title: Previous Calls for Papers
item.content:encoded:
This section lists previous calls for papers from the Human Resource Management Journal. The calls include topics such as reconsidering careers in post-Covid-19 workplaces, caring for healthcare workers and advancing human resource management research in healthcare contexts, research methodologies that offer insights, and interfacing artificial intelligence technologies with human resource management in new firms.

Appel publié par Human Resource Management Journal. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
